title: Kirby’s Dream Land
shortDescription: A compact, approachable platformer that makes simple movement and an unusual inhale ability feel immediately expressive on handheld hardware.
highlights: Short stages make it a friendly entry point for new players
The central ability creates playful interactions without complicated inputs

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A useful Game Boy platforming addition for its clarity, charm, and historical importance to a long-running series.
